title: Sort Colors
summary: Reorder nums in place so all 0s come first, then all 1s, then all 2s.
statement: Reorder nums in place so all 0s come first, then all 1s, then all 2s. Keep all occurrences and do not call a library sort.

examples.explanation: The repeated 2 stays at the end.
The middle color may be absent.

hints: Conceptual: There are only three kinds of entries.
Directional: Count each value before filling the array back in.
Implementation: Write all counted 0s, then 1s, then 2s into the original array.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space in mutable representations.
